title: Audit of c03's metabolic FCH micelles (SIBWDE): body-restricted autocatalysis and amphiphile production make E hold by construction; fission, shell and containment replicate on seed 5 (25 persistent splits, gen 3; feed cut leaves 14/42 founders by t=800 vs 41/42 fed), but at dt/2 division falls to 9 persistent splits and generation 1
summary: Audit (construction and replication); verdict written before reading other reviews. Construction (world.py read line by line): no amphiphile feed; amphiphile is made only as ks c p g with g = (u - u_m)_+ (inside bodies) and degrades everywhere at kdeg, and the catalyst replicates only as kc c p g, so both metabolism and catalyst growth are written against the body field; the precursor is fed uniformly (F (1 - p)); the shell q is made as kq g and drifts up Vq(u), a function of u peaked at the surface; the catalyst is gated by D exp(-beta q); there is no division or death rule (fission is FCH dynamics, death is loss of amphiphile). Replication on new seed 5 to t=800 (audit_runs.txt): fed world 55 bodies, 33 splits, 25 persistent, generation 3, 0 merges, shell rim/core 12.5 (246/246), catalyst body/outside 194x; fork at t=400 (world_cut400.py): body mass 3912 -> 449 and founders alive 42 -> 14 by t=800 while the fed twin grows to 5692 with 41/42 alive. Numerical variant dt/2 (dt 0.01, same physical time): shell 10.6 (151/155), catalyst 358x, but 34 bodies, 31 splits, 9 persistent, generation 1, 5 merges.

verdicts.limitation: Flaws: (1) E holds by construction (amphiphile made only from precursor inside bodies and degraded everywhere); (2) catalyst replication and shell production are restricted to bodies by g = (u - u_m)_+, so containment partly reflects where the code makes the catalyst, and an established finding (20261025T1052-c07-metabolic-no-shell-needed, 20261025T1131-c03-shell-not-beyond-diffusion) shows a gate-free 100x slower catalyst also lives and divides, so W and the shell's role are not beyond diffusion; (3) division is step-size sensitive: at dt/2 on seed 5 the colony reaches only generation 1 (9 persistent splits vs 25 and generation 3 at dt 0.02), so D at the claimed generation depth is not numerically converged on this seed. My fork ran only to t=800 (14/42 founders left), not to the claim's t~1000. One new seed. I list D as not supported; S, I, B, W and E as seen.
